correctness.rationale: Every leaf is necessarily seeded for a 3-color force. Complete disjoint centre-seeding partition gives N2=6*2^(m+n); N1=6*(2^(m+n+1)-2^m-2^n); N0=6*(2^(m+n)-2^m-2^n) by inclusion-exclusion of possible first centres, subtracting only the 6*q_m*q_n cases forceable in either order. The states are necessary and sufficient, and their monomial probability weights yield the result for all m,n>=2. Exhaustive state simulation independently agrees for all m,n in 1..4 (sixteen parameter pairs).
